thread:
Natalie (SI): quick heads-up — Raceway Logistics' staging run failed during our on-prem image validation. hitting a firmware/driver mismatch on the inference host. logs show nvlink timeout + model load OOM on 80% of runs.
Omar S. (Eng): ugh. which image + hw sku?
Natalie (SI): they're using our private image v2026.02 (sha: 4f2c) on Dell R7525 w/ A100S 80GB. platform logs: `nvlink: timeout waiting for link` then `cuda out of memory` despite 60GB reported.
Lee (Platform SME): likely a driver/kernel combo. we saw similar with CUDA 12.2 + DGX firmware flip. can you paste dmesg + nvidia-smi output?
Natalie (SI): pasted the key snippets below — shorted for thread: 
```
[  123.456789] NVRM: GPU 0000:3b:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
[  124.000012] nvlink: error: timeout waiting for link
+-------------------------------+
| nvidia-smi                   |
+-------------------------------+
| Driver Version: 535.86       |
| CUDA Version: 12.1           |
| GPU Memory Usage: 78/80 GB   |
+-------------------------------+
```
Sara (PM): customer is in a hard stop for go-live next week. they want options: rollback to hosted variant, delay, or we fix staging quickly. what do we recommend?
Omar S. (Eng): short term: repro on our lab cluster with same image + driver 535.86. try forcing `NVIDIA_NVLINK=0` to rule out nvlink aggregation? also test kernel 6.5 vs 6.1.
Lee (Platform SME): agree. add a quick kernel/driver matrix: 
- Driver 535.86 + CUDA 12.1 + kernel 6.5 -> repro
- Driver 540.x + CUDA 12.2 + kernel 6.1 -> unknown
We'll try a 540 driver build (known fixes for nvlink stability) and a 12.2 runtime.
Natalie (SI): can you also confirm whether the customer's image includes our inference runtime pinned to `libnvrtc` 11.x? i've seen mismatches cause weird memory accounting.
Omar S. (Eng): good catch. image shows `libnvrtc: 11.5` in /opt/redwood/runtime/lib. that could explain the reported GPU memory not matching.
deploy-bot: [AUTO] created ticket RNW-DEP-4821 (priority: high) — assigned to eng-infra, platform, and si-field.
Sara (PM): plan: 1) eng repro in lab w/ matrix (Omar + Lee) — 4h  2) if repro, build image variant with driver 540 + CUDA12.2 + libnvrtc 12.x and smoke test — 8h 3) coordinate with Raceway for staging window and optional rollback to hosted endpoint (fall-back) — Natalie to coordinate 4) update go-live decision by EOD tomorrow.
Natalie (SI): I'm scheduling a staging window with the customer's infra team at 09:30 PT tomorrow. will share creds and a short runbook. tagging @Omar S. and @Lee to join the call.
Omar S. (Eng): I'll bring a reduced test that loops model load x10 and checks for nvlink timeouts.
Lee (Platform SME): i'll prep a kernel + driver build matrix and a checklist (kernel diff, dtb, pci-e bios settings to verify).
Natalie (SI): thanks — i'll log progress in RNW-DEP-4821 and ping here for major blockers. :thumbsup:
Sara (PM): appreciate the quick triage. please keep updates short here so execs can scan. :eyes:
